text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank you for your hard work today. 
Now then, before heading home, let's pack 
up the gear—ah!
(Clank!)
Whaaahaaa!! I-It's heeeerrreeee!!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh! Fine-senpai...!? Whew, what a 
relief, it's not the ghost everyone was 
talking about.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I'm sorry for startling you. By 
the way, what's this about a rumored 
ghost...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know?! Rumor has it she's been 
showing up at the gym lately!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So get home safe, you guys! I'm gonna 
stick around and practice a bit more, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
H-Heroes aren't afraid of ghosts! I'm 
definitely finishing today's quota...! I 
c-c-can't afford to be scared...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see... Trainer, would it be alright if I 
practiced a little longer?
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself like that...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Say, Biko-chan, may I join you? 
Would you mind telling me all about those 
rumors in detail?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! Word is that at night, a 
skeleton specimen has been doing leg 
presses lately...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! Working out even though he's 
a skeleton...?! Could there be some 
special reason behind this...?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Maybe so... I-If it shows up, let's 
ask it together! A hero always tries to 
persuade before fighting! Right!

And so, Fine Motion did extra practice 
together with Biko Pegasus, who did her 
best despite being scared.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, it's definitely overwork, isn't it. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... are you worried about me? 
...Well, you don't need to be, I'm totally 
fine!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if ghosts show up, I'll take 'em 
down! Even if I'm scared... no, because 
I'm scared, I gotta do my best! So that no 
one else has to be frightened!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...! You are truly brave. Much braver than 
I ever imagined...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I misjudged you. In honor of your courage, 
I bestow upon you this sacred clover 
charm.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A... Awesome! It's just like the 'Sprout 
Talisman' that the Hachimi Princess gives 
you! I can feel the courage welling up 
inside me! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, may blessings be upon you. Good 
night.
